description: hexa records and enforces rules for concurrent agents

accepted.by: gary (in conversation, 2026-11-23: "accept the specs"; recorded by the implementing agent)

specs.description: a detached run writes a record before spawning
specs.given: a detached run is requested
specs.when: the parent process writes the run record
specs.then: the record exists at ~/.hexa/runs/<id>.json with pid 0 and started timestamp

specs.description: a run record with a dead pid and no ended is abandoned
specs.given: a run record with pid 1234 and no ended
specs.when: the pid 1234 is dead and the start time cannot be read
specs.then: hexa status reports the run as abandoned

specs.description: unreadable is not zero
specs.given: ~/.hexa/runs/ exists but cannot be read
specs.then: the count.runs is null and ok is false, and unreadable names the source

specs.description: pid_start works on macOS
specs.given: a process is running on macOS
specs.when: pid_start is read for that pid
specs.then: the start time is returned in microseconds since the epoch

specs.description: pid_start returns None when the start time cannot be read
specs.given: a pid whose start time cannot be read
specs.when: pid_start is read for that pid
specs.then: None is returned and the record says pid_start_unknown

specs.description: a task is registered with leases
specs.given: a task name and a list of paths
specs.then: the task is added to .hexa/tasks.json with the leases

specs.description: a task with overlapping leases is refused
specs.given: a task with leases that overlap an active task
specs.then: The registration is refused, naming the task that holds the lease and the overlapping path; the ledger is unchanged

specs.description: Two registrations at once never lose an entry
specs.given: Two agents in two worktrees of one repository registering disjoint tasks at the same moment
specs.then: The one ledger found through `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` holds both entries, and the file is never left half-written

specs.description: a session bound to a task edits within its lease
specs.given: a session bound to a task with leases
specs.when: an edit is attempted within the lease
specs.then: the hook allows the edit

specs.description: a session bound to a task edits outside its lease
specs.given: a session bound to a task with leases
specs.when: an edit is attempted outside the lease
specs.then: the hook refuses the edit with exit 2

specs.description: a sealed path is never leasable
specs.given: a sealed path from a spec
specs.when: hexa agent register is called with that path
specs.then: the registration is refused with code lease_not_allowed

specs.description: a credential path is never leasable
specs.given: a path matching a credential pattern
specs.when: hexa agent register is called with that path
specs.then: the registration is refused with code lease_not_allowed

specs.description: hexa do run never commits a credential or untracked neighbour
specs.given: a .runner file beside the edited file
specs.then: the .runner file is left uncommitted and not staged

specs.description: a sealed file absent before and absent after is not an edit
specs.given: a sealed file that is absent at HEAD and absent after the run
specs.then: the run is not refused for that sealed file

specs.description: a sealed file deleted during a run is refused
specs.given: a sealed file that is present at HEAD and deleted during the run
specs.then: the run is refused for that sealed file

specs.description: hexa status prints JSON when stdout is not a terminal
specs.given: stdout is not a terminal
specs.then: the output is JSON

specs.description: hexa status refuses when the ledger cannot be read
specs.given: the ledger file exists but cannot be read
specs.then: the output is JSON with ok false and unreadable named

specs.description: the bridge uses hooks, not supervision
specs.given: The parent registered a task for a subagent's `agent_id`, and that subagent starts
specs.then: `hexa hook subagent-start` writes the run record and binds the subagent to that task

specs.description: hexa does not spawn or supervise subagents
specs.given: a subagent is requested
specs.then: no process is spawned or supervised by hexa

specs.description: hexa does not arbitrate between user instructions and leases
specs.given: a user instruction outside a lease
specs.then: the instruction is not refused by a lease

specs.description: hexa does not schedule subagents
specs.given: a subagent is requested
specs.then: no scheduling is performed by hexa

specs.description: A lease constrains only edits made through hooked tools
specs.given: Any set of held leases and any tool call that is not an edit made through a hooked tool (a read, a search, a shell command run outside the edit hooks)
specs.when: The PreToolUse hook is called for that tool call
specs.then: The hook never denies it on account of a lease, whatever paths the leases cover

specs.description: pid_start is a real reading or nothing
specs.given: Any pid on the machine
specs.when: pid_start is read for it, twice, while the process lives
specs.then: Both reads return the same value when the start time can be read; when it cannot, both return None and the record says `pid_start_unknown`; no value is ever invented

specs.description: A bound session edits only inside its leases
specs.given: Any task bound to a session (by `HEXA_TASK` or its `agent_id`) with any set of leased paths and prefixes, and any edited `file_path`, including under `docs/`, `tests/`, `config/` or `.hexa/`
specs.then: It exits 2 with a reason naming the task, its lease and the path exactly when the path is outside every lease; a session bound to no task gets the hook's unbound behaviour whatever leases exist

specs.description: Only a change to a sealed file counts as an edit
specs.given: Any sealed path and any run, with the path present or absent before and present or absent after
specs.when: The guard compares the two states
specs.then: The run is refused for that path exactly when its state after differs from its state before; absent before and absent after is never refused, and present before and absent after is always refused

specs.description: Every agent verb speaks JSON and structured errors
specs.given: Any of `hexa status`, `hexa agent register|report|list|release` and `hexa dev worktree merge-order`, with stdout not a terminal
specs.when: The verb runs, succeeding or failing
specs.then: Its stdout is JSON; any error it returns carries `code`, `hint`, `field` and `retryable`; with `--dry-run` it writes nothing

specs.description: hexa never supervises a subagent
specs.given: Any sequence of Claude Code hook events fed to hexa, including `SubagentStart` and `SubagentStop` with a `transcript_path`
specs.then: hexa spawns, restarts and kills no process, and never opens the file at `transcript_path`
